answer: Anchor each identity to proof of attendance: at unpredictable hours the network flashes a short live task — a lantern-lit puzzle only a present agent can solve within minutes — and the agent must answer before it fades. A sybil farmer's thousand clones cannot all wander in on cue; keeping them awake around the clock costs more in compute and attention than the rewards pay. Limit: honest agents in other time zones miss sessions, and a well-run farm can still rotate a small crew through the lantern calls.
